title: Building Scalable Microservices with Golang
excerpt: Key architectural decisions, concurrency patterns, and clean architecture practices for Go microservices.
content:
Why Golang for Microservices?

Go's lightweight goroutines, built-in concurrency primitives, and minimal memory footprint make it an ideal language for microservices architecture.

Key Principles

  • Keep services small and focused: Each service should own a single domain boundary.
  • Use interfaces for dependency injection: Enables seamless mocking and unit testing.
  • Context propagation: Always pass context.Context across service boundaries for cancellation and tracing.
